# Author context: pump restart procedure

- Audience: operators who may restart a pump after isolation.
- Prerequisites: the separate plant isolation briefing. Page 1.1 declares it to learners.
- Objectives: follow the restart sequence and choose a first action when pressure or gauge readings are unsafe.
- External activities: complete a restart worksheet and bring it to the next shift handoff.
- Completion policy: author intends assessment success on the checks, separate from merely viewing pages. The inspected fixture does not assert an LMS success event.
- Seeded contrast: page 1.3 depends on the optional pressure note at 1.2; page 1.4 states its rule on the check page.

This file records author intent only. It cannot establish that a learner opened the note or completed the worksheet.
